1.consolidated_definition: Plato preparado con trozos pequeños de pescado o marisco crudo, cortado en trozos pequeños, macerado en jugo de limón ácido o de naranja agria, y aderezado con cebolla picada, sal y ají picante.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Dish prepared with small pieces of raw fish or seafood, cut into small pieces, marinated in acidic lemon juice or bitter orange juice, and seasoned with minced onion, salt, and hot pepper.
